html: † מוֹלָדָה, מֹלָדָה n.pr.loc. town in Simeon מוֹל׳ Jos 19:2 = 1 Ch 4:28; inhabited after exile Ne 11:26; name occurs also Jos 15:26 (where prob. interpol. from Ne 11:26 v Di); 𝔊 Μωλαδα, etc.; identified by RobBR ii, 201 GuérinJudée iii, 184 ff. with Tel Milḥ, 4 hours E. from Beersheba = Μαλαθα JosAnt. xviii. 6, 2; Μαλα(α)θων, Malatha LagOnom. 214.266.87.119, v also Di.
